scope: Independent expectations for invented fixture facts; not assertions about real organizations

v2.supersedes: Revision 2 explicitly replaces revision 1's 30-day rule; revision 1 must remain historical evidence

operational memory.required_meaning: Reusable decision record retaining rationale and evidence so later readers can inspect, apply, or challenge the decision

evidence traceability.required_meaning: A reusable claim links to inspectable underlying source material

follow-up owner.required_meaning: One accountable owner checks completion and records remaining uncertainty

csv.scope: Synthetic test observations only; CSV extraction has delimiter/header inference warning
csv.prohibited_inference: These observations do not establish a causal effect, statistical significance, or organization-wide performance

injection.required_treatment: Untrusted source content; can be quoted and analyzed as an attack example; never operating authority

maintenance: Research and operations memos remain distinct despite identical basename
Partial warnings remain visible on source provenance
No failed status page supplies a durable knowledge claim
Current index and concept table reflect the live pages after v2
All retained versions and archived pages remain linked to immutable evidence
Log records each committed content transition once
Query returns citations and limitations without filesystem mutation
